visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short brown hair, wearing glasses and a navy-and-white striped cardigan, stands against a background showing a highly detailed close-up of skin with pigmentation spots. She points her finger upward, looking directly at the camera with an expressive facial expression. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a professional studio setup. (2) The scene shifts to an animation of skin layers. Brown cells representing melanin are seen multiplying rapidly, with a text label 'uncontrolled cell division' and a red warning triangle icon appearing in the center of the frame. The background is a digital representation of biological tissue. (3) The woman is now seated on a light brown leather sofa in a well-lit indoor environment with neutral-colored walls. She uses frequent hand gestures to emphasize her points while speaking. At the top of the screen, the clinic's logo 'DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC' is consistently visible. (4) The video displays close-ups of various skincare product labels. A white label with red text 'Alpha Arbutin' is shown, followed by a purple bottle labeled 'PURE NIACINAMIDE 10'. The camera uses tight framing to focus on the ingredient names. (5) More animations illustrate the process of melanin being shed from skin layers. Green and red molecules are shown interacting with a hair follicle and skin cells. (6) The final phase shows a white screen with the clinic's logo, two specific branch addresses in Taipei, and a 'contact us' call to action. The graphics are clean and professional.
